career_spells.employer: Drakes Supermarkets (profile label; earlier local operator to verify)
career_spells.evidence_note: Public profile supplies months and casual label. Official biography confirms supermarket work. Drakes is family-owned; 2024 employer release says Yankalilla opened in 2022, so exact 2018–2022 employer/ownership succession needs checking. Casual is preserved here; schema has no casual value and full-time hours are not inferred. Local historical society dates Foodland-to-Drakes change to1August2022. Earlier operator and individual transfer/payroll remain unknown; retain overarching retail interval without assigning all four years to later brand. ABR history identifies The Fourth Force Pty Ltd(ABN22 084 438 773), an Australian Private Company, as registered holder of Drakes Yankalilla from8June2022. This predates1August2022banner change but is not her personal transfer date; pre2022operator and actual payroll employer remain unknown. A different store employee, Brigitt De Laine, states in a 2024 Fair Work Commission submission that her Foodland employment transferred to Drakes sometime in2021. This conflicts with2022store-transition accounts; transaction date, branding date and each employee transfer cannot be equated. Walker individual transfer remains unverified.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

research_notes: Initial review 2026-10-01: frozen official occupation list supplemented by employer statement, primary personal/party accounts, public professional profile and reliable reporting. No roster refresh. Childcare and insurance jobs omitted from frozen occupation list explicitly preserved as unresolved spells.

Retail dates are month-precision self-report, not verified payroll. The Drakes employer account of Yankalilla opening in 2022 raises a predecessor/operator question for 2018–2022. Do not claim continuous employment by a particular Drakes legal entity until reconciled.

Searches of exact profile, Health Partners and childcare did not independently confirm employer names or precise additional dates. An unsolicited contact-aggregator result suggests Health Partners customer experience December 2023–June 2024, but it was not opened and that lead is not promoted to a factual spell. Follow public primary profile or employer evidence next; do not gather contact details. UK childcare-manager namesakes excluded.

Full-time evidence absent. Casual retail work remains unknown in approved enum; political staff part-time rests on secondary reporting. Student and volunteer overlaps preclude automatic continuous full-time assumptions. Union/party/study/elected office excluded; no zero inferred for public or private employment.

Follow-up: childcare identity/duties/dates/control, insurance legal employer and nonprofit status, retail predecessor/contract/hours, MP and union exact dates and leave, Young Labor end and remuneration. Last follow-up 2026-10-01. Next initial member Penny Wong.

Follow-up2026-10-02: independently public professional profile confirms Health Partners customer-support role December2023–June2024; former contact-aggregator lead no longer sole basis. Historical employer statement establishes mutual nonprofit control and classification. Unknown hours retained.

Contemporaneous31July2022historical-society post gives1August2022Foodland-to-Drakes transition, but not individual employment-transfer date. Targeted childcare queries returned UK/USnamesakes and general childcare-administration summaries; no Australian primary employer identification. No namesakejobs assigned. Next seek childcare employer, retail predecessor payroll and ASU/member-officecontract dates.

Follow-up2026-10-04: public professional-profile indexing narrows Leon Bignell electorate-office service to November2022–November2023; the independently reported few-days-a-week arrangement remains the basis for part-time status. A 2026 secondary profile describes the otherwise unidentified childcare work as administration, but employer, dates, hours and control remain unknown. No full-time headline interval was inferred.

Follow-up2026-10-04: ABR historical business-name record identifies The Fourth Force Pty Ltd as Drakes Yankalilla registered holder from8June2022, adding legal-entity context to the documented August2022store transition. It does not prove Walker’s personal payroll transfer, appointment or hours and is not retroactively assigned to2018–2022. Childcare query again yields UK founder/older residential-care worker namesakes, rejected; Adelaide course dates/title unresolved. Next: predecessor operator’s historical business-name entry and personal transfer/payroll, childcare employer/contract, ASU exact boundaries and study record.

Follow-up2026-10-05: new primary FWC witness statement from a different Yankalilla employee reports Foodland-to-Drakes employment transfer sometime in2021, conflicting with contemporary2022banner/opening accounts. Preserve conflict, not Walker appointment/hours. ABR29075563273 identifies Trustee for Yankalilla Retail Unit Trust active2011–2026 but no business-name or individual payroll bridge; ABR92096896963 former Yankalilla Foodland IGA name ended2011 and GST ended2017, so not retroactively assigned to2018job.
